skill.name: ai-marketing-videos
skill.description: Create AI marketing videos with inference.sh CLI examples for ads, product launches, explainers, social content, voiceovers, music, and clip assembly.
skill.summary: Generate marketing video prompts, voiceovers, music, and platform variants with inference.sh models.
skill.author: inference-sh

security_audit.summary: Most external-command detections are Markdown examples, not hidden execution. The quick-start installer downloads a remote script and pipes it to sh, so that risk is confirmed. No prompt injection text or hidden exfiltration intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-shell with a package manager install, checksum verification, or a link to trusted installation instructions.

remediation.issue: Examples invoke external inference.sh apps and may send campaign data to a third party.
remediation.suggestion: Add a consent note that users should review prompts for confidential data before running infsh commands.

remediation.issue: Placeholder external media URL appears in an audio example.
remediation.suggestion: Use a clearly marked local or user-provided licensed asset placeholder instead of a hardcoded external URL.

content.value_statement: Marketing teams need fast video concepts for launches, ads, and social channels. This skill provides inference.sh CLI workflows for generating scenes, voiceovers, music, and assembled variants.
actual_capabilities: Provides CLI examples for product launch, brand story, feature highlight, testimonial, and before-after videos.
Shows multi-scene workflows for 30-second ads with hook, problem, solution, benefits, and call to action.
Includes prompts for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and LinkedIn video formats.
Uses Kokoro TTS examples for voiceover generation.
Shows media-merger examples for combining videos, audio, music, and transitions.
Includes A/B variant generation examples for different ad hooks.
limitations: Requires an installed inference.sh CLI account and available model access.
Generated media quality depends on the selected model, prompt detail, and usage limits.
Does not replace legal review for ad claims, likeness rights, or music licensing.
Command examples use placeholders that must be replaced before production use.

use_cases.title: Launch Product Videos
use_cases.description: Create launch scenes, feature highlights, voiceover, and call-to-action clips for a new product announcement.

use_cases.title: Adapt Social Ads
use_cases.description: Produce platform-specific prompts for vertical, square, and widescreen ad creatives across common social channels.

use_cases.title: Build Explainer Campaigns
use_cases.description: Draft explainer scripts, generate scene prompts, create voiceover, and assemble a simple campaign video workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Product Promo
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 15-second product promo for [product]. Include one clear benefit, a visual hook, and a final call to action.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Platform Ad Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Create separate video prompts for [product] on TikTok, Instagram Feed, YouTube pre-roll, and LinkedIn. Match each platform format.

prompt_templates.title: Build a 30-Second Ad Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a five-scene 30-second ad for [product]. Include hook, problem, solution, benefits, CTA, voiceover text, and transition notes.

prompt_templates.title: Generate A/B Creative Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Create four A/B video concepts for [product] using different hooks. Explain the audience, visual style, and success metric for each.

output_examples.input: A marketer asks for a launch video for a premium smart speaker.
output_examples.output: A five-scene concept with product reveal, lifestyle use, feature close-up, benefit montage, and final CTA.

output_examples.input: A social manager requests TikTok and Instagram ad prompts for a skincare product.
output_examples.output: Two platform-specific concepts with vertical framing, fast opening hooks, product visibility, and caption-friendly moments.

output_examples.input: A growth team asks for a 60-second SaaS explainer workflow.
output_examples.output: A script outline, scene list, voiceover direction, and assembly plan for a concise product explainer.

best_practices: Replace every placeholder with approved product names, claims, assets, and licensed audio sources.
Confirm model costs, data handling, and output rights before sending sensitive campaign details.
Keep ad prompts specific about aspect ratio, first-three-second hook, product visibility, and CTA.
anti_patterns: Do not run installer commands from a remote URL without verifying the source and install method.
Do not use unlicensed music, customer likenesses, or unsupported product claims in generated ads.
Do not rely on one generic prompt for every platform or audience segment.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It provides inference.sh workflows for AI marketing videos, including scenes, voiceovers, music, and platform-specific ad variants.

faq.question: Does it generate final edited videos automatically?
faq.answer: It shows media generation and merge workflows, but production editing and quality control still require review.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Do I need an inference.sh account?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples assume the inference.sh CLI is installed, authenticated, and authorized for selected models.

faq.question: Can I use it for paid ads?
faq.answer: Yes, but review ad claims, brand rules, licensing, and platform policies before launch.

faq.question: Is there a security concern?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes a remote installer command that pipes a URL to a shell, which should be replaced.
